news.headline: Ceuta migrant influx reignites immigration divisions in Europe
news.summary: The arrival of 60,000 people into the Spanish North African enclave of Ceuta from Morocco last week has created serious tensions within the EU over immigration. Spain has called for a meeting of EU interior ministers which is due to take place Tuesday.

news.headline: Bridge collapse in DR Congo reignites debate about mining revenues
news.summary: Several people ended up in the river after an important bridge collapsed on June 3 in the village of Hombo in the eastern part of the DRC. The bridge is one of the failing critical infrastructures in a territory that is home to one of the most lucrative mines in the region.

news.headline: "The situation is out of control": Greek firefighters battle wildfire for fourth day
news.summary: Greek firefighters are battling a wildfire northwest of Athens for the fourth day, as strong and erratic winds continue to fan the blaze. Fires throughout the country have killed five firefighters since last week.
